gloss: no shoes allowed; shoes strictly prohibited

definitions.gloss: no shoes allowed; shoes strictly prohibited
definitions.explanation: A common sign or rule indicating that outdoor shoes must not be worn in a particular area. Found at the entrance of Japanese homes, temples, certain restaurants, and other spaces where shoes must be removed.

examples.japanese: ここは{土足厳禁|どそくげんきん}です。
{入口|いりぐち}に「{土足厳禁|どそくげんきん}」の{表示|ひょうじ}があった。
examples.english: There was a 'no shoes' sign at the entrance.

examples.japanese: この{体育館|たいいくかん}は{土足厳禁|どそくげんきん}なので、{上履|うわば}きに{履|は}き{替|か}えてください。
examples.english: This gymnasium is a no-shoes area, so please change into indoor shoes.

notes:
{土足厳禁|どそくげんきん} is a common sign in Japan meaning "no outdoor shoes allowed." Composed of {土足|どそく} (outdoor shoes, literally "earth feet") + {厳禁|げんきん} (strictly prohibited).

WHERE YOU SEE IT:
- {旅館|りょかん} (traditional inns) and {寺|てら} (temples)
- {体育館|たいいくかん} (gymnasiums) and {道場|どうじょう} (martial arts halls)
- {学校|がっこう} (schools)
- Traditional {和食|わしょく} restaurants with tatami rooms

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {靴|くつ}を{脱|ぬ}いでください: Please take off your shoes
- {上履|うわば}き: indoor shoes
- {下駄箱|げたばこ}: shoe cupboard/rack (at entrances)

OTHER 〜{厳禁|げんきん} SIGNS:
- {撮影|さつえい}{厳禁|げんきん}: photography strictly prohibited
- {火気|かき}{厳禁|げんきん}: no open flames
